To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) participants described a number of different ways of treating themselves; (b) pleasure in eating was described in terms of social eating rather than the food itself, (c) participants described engaging in highly restricted eating, (d) participants did not relate the idea of self-kindness to their physical health behaviors.
the participants described a range of ways of treating and caring for themselves through food and other activities, but there was a disconnection with the notion of being kind to themselves.
the concept of self-kindness in relation to eating behaviors and other health behaviors is a novel one and that it is a concept that is not easily understood or accepted by the participants.
